sources.entry: Image-As-Wallpaper - Utility application helps with selection of images for using as desktop wallpaper or in screensaver on Mac computers.

summary.one_liner: A macOS utility written in Swift that checks a set of images against the screen's aspect ratio and dimensions to find which ones suit use as a desktop wallpaper or screensaver.
summary.what_it_does: The app takes a set of images selected by the user and compares each image's aspect ratio and dimensions with the computer screen. It reports how many images are good (suitable for wallpaper) and how many are bad. The user can move or delete the images from the app. Screen dimensions can be changed dynamically, and the user can adjust the conformity level. Images can be zoomed in the views, which are Image Kit Browser Views.
use_cases: find images that fit my screen resolution
pick screensaver photos with the right aspect ratio
remove or move unsuitable wallpaper images
check image dimensions against a display
notable: Compares each image's aspect ratio and dimensions to the current screen
Adjustable conformity level for matching images
Screen dimensions can be changed at runtime
Lets the user move or delete bad images from the app
Built on Image Kit Browser Views with zoom support
caveats: The README gives no build or install instructions
Built with Xcode 6.3, an old toolchain, so it may not build on current macOS without changes
The README does not state a license or maintenance status
